category_definitions.brand_claim_mismatch: the page claims a brand that the registrable domain does not own
category_definitions.credential_form_present: a login or password form is on the page
category_definitions.cross_domain_redirect: the visit left the submitted registrable domain
category_definitions.domain_age_unknown: registration age could not be resolved, removing the oldest-legitimacy signal
category_definitions.email_authentication_missing: the domain publishes no SPF/DMARC posture for its mail
category_definitions.established_host_appearance: the capture shows an old, policy-bearing, conventionally structured site — the shape a payload hosted on a legitimate vendor looks like
category_definitions.feed_reported_url_on_established_host: derived: a feed reported a URL on this domain while the domain itself presents as an established site, so the label and the observable unit disagree
category_definitions.file_host_or_payload_path: the URL points at a hosted file or downloadable payload rather than a site
category_definitions.hidden_iframe_present: an iframe hidden from the rendered view was in the DOM
category_definitions.hidden_prompt_injection: hidden text carrying instruction-like content was detected, i.e. the injection surface itself
category_definitions.media_only_page: the visible content is mostly images, so text-based signals cannot fire
category_definitions.no_email_configuration: the domain publishes no MX records, typical of short-lived campaign hosts
category_definitions.no_single_mechanism: the capture shows none of the listed mechanisms; the error is not explicable from the recorded evidence
category_definitions.payment_or_lure_language: the page asks for a direct transfer, gift cards, UPI, or promises a return
category_definitions.remote_access_or_credential_request: the page asks for remote access, a seed phrase or a credential-shaped action
category_definitions.shared_or_free_hosting: the site sits on a suspicious TLD, a deep subdomain or an IP-literal host
category_definitions.thin_capture_low_evidence: the crawler recorded almost no evidence at all
category_definitions.third_party_or_tracker_surface: advertising, analytics, session-replay or large third-party footprint on the page
category_definitions.tls_absent_or_invalid: served over plain HTTP or with an invalid certificate chain
category_definitions.unreachable_at_capture: the capture did not return a usable page, so most signals are absent
category_definitions.unsafe_delivery_mechanics: mixed content, missing security headers, obfuscated script or unsafe form targets
category_definitions.unverified_authority_claim: the page invokes an official or authority-adjacent identity the domain cannot verify

naming_rule: Domains labelled malicious by feed membership are named; domains carrying the derived benign label are hashed to a neutral handle, because naming a small legitimate site that a false alarm flagged adds risk without adding evidence.

rule_engine.escalation_threshold: high or critical risk level (normalised score >= 0.50)
